name: Volatility contraction breakout
idea: On the Daily chart: a signal on the first close beyond the pivot of a base whose pullbacks keep getting shallower (a volatility contraction pattern); the idea is wrong below the last contraction.

params.label: Contractions
params.help: The base needs at least this many pullbacks, each shallower than the one before.

params.label: Shallower by
params.help: Each pullback must be at most this share of the one before (1 means just shallower).

params.label: Volume expansion
params.help: The breakout bar's volume must be at least this many times the average (0 means no volume condition; indices have no volume).

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the pivot the close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: Trend filter
params.help: Only when the longer-term trend template holds (rising long averages, the close well off its yearly low).

params.label: Volume dry-up
params.help: Only when volume dries up through the base (turn it off for indices, which have no volume).

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The level that says the breakout failed: the low of the last contraction, or just beyond the pivot.

params.label: Edge buffer
params.help: For 'just beyond the broken pivot': how many average true ranges beyond it.
